title: Art Lab Everett

services.name: Art Lab birthday party
services.desc: Art Lab Everett, founded in early 2020, has been dedicated to supporting art education and fostering connections within the community. As they look ahead, the organization aspires to continue fundraising for another five years. To celebrate their achievements over the years, Art Lab Everett is hosting its 5th anniversary event at 132 Bucknam St., Everett, MA, on July 11th, with a rain date of July 18th, and will run from 3 pm to 6 pm. The event offers free food, hands-on art activities, local Everett performers, and youth vendors! In collaboration with Ruth Catherine, a community mural project will be available to the public! Attendees of all backgrounds are free to celebrate and support

blurb: Arts for Everett is an artist-run nonprofit and community art space dedicated to making creative experiences available to everyone. Our flagship location, Art Lab Everett, welcomes all to explore artmaking as a consistent practice through our open hours and fee-scaled membership.
